topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Oh my gosh, can you even believe it? Same teacher, decades apart! It’s like a sweet little echo from my past, now a part of their journey too. I can barely sit still thinking about all the stories I’ll have to share, the little nuggets of wisdom that stuck with me. Guess I’ll be the coolest parent at pick-up time, dropping all these hints about how much I know. And you just wait, the bond my kid and I will forge over this—I can feel it. It’s gonna be epic. Can’t wait to see how they take to it, what they learn, and how they grow from it, just like I did.
